messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 page: customer AegisBank (dedicated pool aegis-prod-us) is seeing widespread 429s (>30% requests 429 over 5m). Auto-alerting runbook: dedicated-rate-exceed.

maya_oncall: saw the alert, joining. checking console now.

maya_oncall: console shows sustained 429s from tenant aegis-bank-123, spikes started ~5m ago after a batch job. latency still OK for others.

alex_garcia: paging in — on-call for infra today. @maya_oncall handoff?

maya_oncall: handing off to @alex_garcia. I pulled logs: KV cache fill spike, and a lot of concurrent warmup requests from a single API key.

samir_khan: adding context from product: AegisBank is enterprise VPC customer on a reserved dedicated pool (aegis-prod-us). They have a high-burst clause but not unlimited. Sales may need to sign off for emergency overage.

jess_platform: runbook step 1: confirm isolation possible. runbook step 2: divert noisy tenant. link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-rate-exceed

alex_garcia: running quick hypothesis check — is this traffic coming from a single region or multiple?

ops-bot: Traffic summary (5m): total requests=18,432; 429s=5,728; top api_key=aegis-bank-123 (68% of 429s). top model=gptx-8k-quant.

alex_garcia: ok. action plan: 1) enable tenant isolation (redirect aegis-bank-123 to isolated node group), 2) enable emergency burst capacity (+2 GPUs) on aegis-prod-us, 3) temporarily relax token limit for that tenant if sales approves.

maya_oncall: I'm going to start the tenant isolation now (non-disruptive routing) — this routes new requests to an isolated slice, old connections keep running.

alex_garcia: command I ran (audit):
```
# move tenant to isolated slice
redwoodctl tenant-isolate --tenant aegis-bank-123 --pool aegis-prod-us --slice isolated-2024-11-14
```

ops-bot: tenant isolation triggered. new requests for aegis-bank-123 now landing on isolated-2024-11-14.

lia_customer_success: pinging AegisBank CSM and technical contact to warn about possible increased latencies during mitigation. Lia on call.

samir_khan: we should also enable fallback model for that tenant to reduce token pressure. Jess, can you flip model to gptx-4k-quant for that tenant?

jess_platform: starting canary config change for tenant:
```
# per-tenant routing override
redwoodctl set-tenant-config --tenant aegis-bank-123 --model gptx-4k-quant --rate-limit 120rpm
```

ops-bot: config push succeeded for tenant aegis-bank-123 (model override + rate-limit).

alex_garcia: I'm seeing 429 rate drop from 68% -> 22% in first 60s after isolation and fallback. Good signal.

incident-bot: Incident timeline note: 2143654321 root alert created. automated mitigation attempted: tenant isolation + fallback model.

maya_oncall: still seeing a tail of 429s from older connections, and some batch job retries. We should cut retries at proxy if possible.

alex_garcia: adding a retry-suppress rule for that api_key at edge (5xx/429-> no automatic retry).

alex_garcia: edge rule applied: no-retry for api_key=aegis-bank-123.

ops-bot: 10m after mitigation: total requests=28,002; 429s=1,512 (5.4%). Good stabilization but still above baseline.

ryan_sales: @alex_garcia @samir_khan FYI sales approves emergency burst billing for AegisBank up to +48 GPU-hours with standard emergency rate. Please provide exact estimate.

alex_garcia: estimate: +2xV100s equivalent for next 2h -> ~4 GPU-hours immediate, if we keep burst for 12h it's ~24 GPU-hours. I'll request ramp only if 429s climb.

samir_khan: customer impact: degraded throughput for long seq requests, clients hitting 429. CSM Lia notified SLA breach potential.

lia_customer_success: AegisBank support thread: "We're seeing a bunch of 429s on our ingest pipeline, retries causing backpressure. Is there a quick bypass?" I replied: "We've isolated your traffic and applied a smaller model; our infra team is monitoring — we'll coordinate any temporary uplift with you."

alex_garcia: next steps: 1) monitor 15m window; 2) let sales finalize emergency uplift if needed; 3) prepare rollback after stabilization; 4) root-cause follow-up (investigate batch job and client retry logic).

maya_oncall: logging runbook note and assigning postmortem: owner @samir_khan.

samir_khan: assigned. I'll own RCA and contact AegisBank to understand the change that triggered spike.

jess_platform: post-incident config capture:
```
tenant:aegis-bank-123
  original_model: gptx-8k-quant
  override_model: gptx-4k-quant
  rate_limit: 120rpm
  isolation_slice: isolated-2024-11-14
```

ops-bot: metric snapshot (after mitigation): token-rate per-second down 65%, latency p95 up 12% for that tenant during the immediate mitigation window.

alex_garcia: one outstanding ask: whitelist for emergency admin key so we can test without triggering tenant limits. Creating temp admin key TTL 1h.

ops-bot: admin test key created (masked).

ryan_sales: I created a PO and emailed finance for emergency uplift approval. Lia to keep customer in loop for billing.

lia_customer_success: AegisBank acknowledged the mitigation and asked for ETA for normal service. I told them we'll aim to revert model override after 30m of stable <1% 429s.

maya_oncall: monitoring window: starting 30m. will page if >3% 429s resurfaces.

incident-bot: summary note appended to incident log: mitigations applied: tenant isolation, fallback model, rate-limit, retry suppression, admin test key, sales emergency uplift requested.

alex_garcia: any action to blacklist client IPs? I see a noisy internal batch host from AegisBank — best to talk to customer before blackholing.

lia_customer_success: customer wants us to throttle rather than block. we will ask them to patch retries on their side.

samir_khan: RCA next steps: capture request traces, identify root source of batch job (cron vs human). I'll pull traces and schedule a call with Aegis infra tomorrow.

maya_oncall: thanks team. handing back to monitoring. I'm marking as mitigated for now but keeping incident live until postmortem.

alex_garcia: logging follow-up tasks into the incidents tracker. closing on-call handoff.

lia_customer_success: sending official post-mitigation note to customer now.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> on-call monitoring.

maya_oncall: last check: 30m window complete, 429s averaged 0.7% for tenant, baseline recovered. Scheduling RCA doc.

samir_khan: I'll create the RCA doc and include recommended guardrails: per-tenant burst windows, automatic client retry-suppression, and better billing automation for emergency uplifts.

jess_platform: adding config to suggest model-fallback profiles automatically if token-rate spike detected.

alex_garcia: thanks everyone.

lia_customer_success: AegisBank: "Appreciate the quick response. We'll update our batch job to exponential backoff." :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident closed to active monitoring at 2143655900.
